headings.usage: Use for all major headings (H1, H2, H3) to establish a premium, high-end 'Max/Apollo' healthcare feel. Do not use generic sans-serif for headings.

body.usage: Use for all body text, paragraphs, buttons, and form inputs for high legibility.

glassmorphism.usage: Use on Sticky Navbar, Floating Action Buttons, and Hero overlay cards.
glassmorphism.classes: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-black/60 border border-white/20 dark:border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)]

cards.classes: bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700 hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300

marketing.hero: Full-width slider with glassmorphic info-cards overlaid. Left-aligned typography.
marketing.services: Bento Grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6). Mix of spans for visual interest.
marketing.gallery: Masonry grid layout with lightbox capability.
marketing.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 for sections. Use gap-8 or gap-12.

admin_dashboard.widgets: Dense, highly legible grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6).
admin_dashboard.surface: Flat solid surfaces only. DO NOT use glassmorphism in the dashboard to ensure data clarity.

interactions: Smooth scroll initialized via Lenis for premium momentum scrolling.

Animated counting for the 'Happy Patients', 'Recovery Rate' stats (use framer-motion/react-countup).
Auto-sliding Hero and Testimonial carousels (Swiper or pure Framer Motion).

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, toggles) MUST include data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case-role.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Build a premium, high-end healthcare website that rivals top corporate hospitals (Apollo/Max). Use the designated #0B8FD3 primary color generously for actions, and Playfair Display for authoritative, elegant headings.
instructions_to_main_agent.technical: Use HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts to ensure creative freedom, but utilize Shadcn UI heavily customized for forms, accordions, tabs, and the admin dashboard. Note: Files are in .js/.jsx, do not use .tsx.
instructions_to_main_agent.forms: The Appointment form must be multi-step and include file upload UI (Shadcn forms).
instructions_to_main_agent.admin: The admin dashboard must feel like a completely separate, dense, data-rich application (no glassmorphism, use standard flat Shadcn styling).
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: MANDATORY: Every button, link, and input must have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='book-appointment-btn').
instructions_to_main_agent.transparency: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or surfaces holding content. Always use solid or glassmorphism (bg-white/70 + backdrop-blur).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
